column4: A heavy cardboard box full of bottles and tins lifted off a wooden pallet outdoors: a scrape of cardboard on wood, a dull clink of glass inside, a short grunt-free lift, close, no music, no voices.
A heavy cardboard box full of bottles and tins set down on the ground outdoors: a soft heavy cardboard thump and a muffled clink of glass inside, close, no music, no voices.
